notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
The entire game has been re-lit to accommodate for OpenGL Rendering -- Allowing for Linux and Mac version releases. (coming very soon)
New graphic options available to accommodate for lower end systems.
Highest Settings FPS
Lowest Settings FPS
Options to disable the player model have been added.
Options for shadow quality added.
The Jump Jet particle effects have been removed.  It was more annoying than useful.  Instead, there is a new flight path ribbon following player color choices. Option to be disabled.

notes.title: PAX and Launch Aftermath
notes.content:
Just finished our last day at PAX Prime.  Tons of good feedback, met a lot of awesome people, about 40 people completed the challenge for a free copy of APT!  Now that we're done here, were going to get to work as soon as we're all home.

High priority fixes:

Memory leak causing crashes after restarting a number of times.
Friends only leaderboard not displaying the correct times.
Weird character model glitch while walking on certain surfaces.

Releasing Linux and Mac builds.
Changing the lighting solution.



Additionally,  we will be releasing free levels packs as well as new game features in the near future.

Thank you everyone so far for the support!

notes.title: APT Launch Ready!
notes.content:
Launch patch notes

Achievements weren't being awarded properly -- fixed
Leaderboards now default to friends only.
Keybinding options available
New initial setup for display and quality settings
New victory sounds
Gamma adjustments added to display options
Added color grading options
New area that shows your position in global leaderboards
Filters for trial ranks now work
Music replaced
Game now launches properly with correct resolution
New challenges now have a passable score as well as steam achievements

Unfortunately, Linux and Mac versions will not be available on launch. They will added ASAP!

We will be at PAX Prime!

Come visit us at PAX Prime in the Indie Rising section.  Try APT - win a free copy- pick up some swag.

Have fun!
